item.title: OpenAI Details GPT-Live’s Architecture for Continuous Stateful Voice Interaction
item.description: OpenAI recently published an engineering account of GPT-Live. It described how they designed the system to maintain continuous voice interaction while separating latency-sensitive media processing from broader application work. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Three sites made 215,128 “best software” pages for AI. Perplexity cites them
item.description: Across 380 software categories, 59.8% of the sources behind grounded AI recommendations sit outside the 100,000 most-visited websites, and several of the most-cited are sites built to be read by models rather than by people. (1 source: hackernews)
